title: Choisir le monde visuel du site public
question: The roll assigned La signalétique, a plain wayfinding system. Keep it, take Impeccable’s pick or the category standard, or re-roll. Mockup images are unavailable (the OpenAI key is deactivated), so the build is code-first and each card shows a phone layout sketch.

options.label: La signalétique
options.lineage: Airport and bus-station wayfinding (Frutiger's Roissy signage, FHB airport, gare routière boards)
options.thesis: The site is a sign system for an insurance decision: every page says where you are, what is indicative and who confirms.
materials: flat navy sign panels with white type
pictograms built from a few flat planes
a route line with numbered stops
options.viewport: Phone: logo bar, then one navy directory sign with the headline and the country, then the product rows (pictogram, name, arrow) as the working entry, then the route Comparez, Demandez un devis, Le courtier confirme.
options.risk: If the route and pictograms are over-played it slides toward a transit theme; it must stay flat signage, never a station costume.

raised.raise: One fixed label grid rules every offer card: product, insurer, indicative price, status, who confirms, always in the same place.
One state language site-wide: solid means confirmed by the broker, outlined means indicative or to confirm.
Palette law: each colour means one thing everywhere (navy navigation, green done, amber sponsored) and is never decoration.
The logo blue is owned at full strength on the sign panels instead of being scattered as accents.
Product pictograms are drawn from a few flat planes with no outlines; every element on a page has a job.
On the offer list, columns never move; sponsored or unavailable rows restyle without breaking the grid.

regions.label: next: ce que nous ne faisons pas

options.label: Le guichet
options.lineage: Plain public-service web writing (service-public.fr, GOV.UK discipline), without any state insignia
options.thesis: A service counter that explains before it asks: plain text, numbered steps, and the important limits set in inset panels.
materials: inset panels with a thick left rule
options.viewport: Phone: logo bar, a large left-aligned headline, a two-field form (pays, produit) with one solid button, then a 'Bon à savoir' inset panel with the role sentence, then numbered steps.
options.risk: The most familiar of the three and where most runs in this category land; it can feel administrative and must never look like a government site.

options.label: Le tableau des départs
options.thesis: Offers as a departure board: fixed columns, rows ranked by score, status lamps.
options.viewport: A dark board of products and offers with flap animation.
options.case: Fuses into a clear offer board, but dark condensed caps read badly on a phone and the flap motion is the kind of effect you ruled out.
options.kept: Columns never move; row states restyle without breaking the grid (raise on the offer list).

options.label: Le ruban de provenance
options.thesis: The quote request as a custody ribbon: who holds it, when, and what is confirmed.
options.viewport: A single ribbon column tracing the request from consent to broker.
options.case: Matches the transmission story, but archival buff and ledger serifs are foreign to the visitor and slow on a phone.
options.kept: Solid for confirmed, outlined for indicative: one state language everywhere.

options.label: Le mur de boîtes
options.thesis: Products as stacked boxes with end labels.
options.viewport: A wall of product boxes; open a lid to see offers.
options.case: No link to insurance or to the visitor's world; lid hinges add steps.
options.kept: A fixed label grid that rules every card.

options.label: L'écran d'arcade
options.thesis: Offers as sprites on a pixel grid.
options.case: Contradicts a calm money decision and 'not fancy'.
options.kept: Palette law: a colour has one meaning.

options.label: Le programme monochrome
options.viewport: A full-bleed blue page with a swept logotype.
options.case: Strong recognition but a toy-like gloss that undercuts a regulated money decision.
options.kept: Own the logo blue at full strength where it is used.

options.label: Les plans Tanaka
options.thesis: Figures rebuilt from a few flat colour planes.
options.viewport: A poster figure with a whisper caption.
options.case: Beautiful but a poster, not a comparator; the offer and the action would be hidden.
options.kept: Pictograms from a few flat planes; every element has a job.

canonCard.label: Le comparateur classique
canonCard.thesis: What insurance comparators ship: a search form hero, product tiles, three steps, reassurance, FAQ, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Phone: logo bar, headline, a card with country and product selects and a blue button, then product tiles.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every comparator, including today's site without its gradients.
